what_is.heading: What Are Tap Simulator Tokens and What Can You Buy With Them?
paragraphs: Tokens are Tap Simulator's premium currency. You spend them on gamepasses, limited eggs, boosts and pets from other players in the Trading Plaza.
There are two kinds. Free Tokens you earn in-game can't be traded. Paid Tokens, bought with Robux or earned by selling to other players, can be traded.

delivery.heading: How Tap Simulator Token Delivery Works
steps: After checkout, send your Roblox username in the order chat.
Join Tap Simulator and go to the Trading Plaza.
Follow the seller's delivery note to receive the Tokens, either through a trade or a sale at your booth.
Check your Token balance, then confirm the order.
delivery.typical_time: Sellers on DropMarket quote about 15 minutes while they're online.

support_topic.heading: Why Can't I Trade My Tap Simulator Tokens?
paragraphs: Tokens you earned for free, from quests, codes or bosses, can't be traded. Only Paid Tokens, the ones bought with Robux or earned from other players, move between accounts.
Tokens you buy on DropMarket arrive through trading, so they count as tradeable Tokens.

faq_extra.q: How do you get Tokens in Tap Simulator for free?
faq_extra.a: Redeem codes, finish quests, join events and farm bosses. Those Tokens are free Tokens, so you can spend them but not trade them.
